name: Group Header 116
definition: Provides further details on the message.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the account servicing institution, and sent to the account owner or the party authorised to receive the message, to unambiguously identify the message.|Usage: The account servicing institution has to make sure that MessageIdentification is unique per account owner for a pre-agreed period.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the message was created.

MessageRecipient.name: Message Recipient
MessageRecipient.definition: Party authorised by the account owner to receive information about movements on the account.|Usage: MessageRecipient should only be identified when different from the account owner.

MessagePagination.name: Message Pagination
MessagePagination.definition: Provides details on the page number of the message.||Usage: The pagination of the message is only allowed when agreed between the parties.

OriginalBusinessQuery.name: Original Business Query
OriginalBusinessQuery.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the original requestor, to unambiguously identify the business query message.
